svg.text: veroboard-usb-v1: 33 holes x 11 strips, 86.4 x 30.5 mm, 14 track cuts, 9 wire links
Strips run left to right. Columns are numbered along the top, strips down the sides; the copper side is mirrored, as you see it with the board turned over.
Copper side (board turned over left to right): cut the strips at the red marks
Diodes: the band (cathode) is drawn at the end marked. The module sits chip side up on its header pins, soldered, never socketed. L1-L5 go under the module: fit them first.
